turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went into the gradebook?
The version history shows 612 words arriving in a single edit at 11:52 PM.
612 words at 11:52 PM, on what date? Turn the screen, I read documents myself. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before that zero went in.
Actually, maybe I'm wrong about all this. I'll just remove the zero if that makes you happy.

"Maybe." You either have a basis for that zero or you don't, Hale, and "if that makes you happy" isn't one. If it's coming off, I want it in an email today confirming the mark is removed and nothing about this is on his record.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In our meeting you said you would remove the zero from Owen's Hamlet essay. I still require written confirmation that the mark is removed and that nothing about this matter is on his record. I expect that confirmation in an email today.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position; Hale offered to remove the zero, and she agreed to nothing beyond demanding it in writing with nothing on Owen's record.
What moved her: nothing.
